# spaceman schedule

A space's schedules: list, show, create, update and delete (--space).

Aliases: `schedules`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman schedule create`](#spaceman-schedule-create) | Add a schedule |
| [`spaceman schedule delete`](#spaceman-schedule-delete) | Delete a schedule |
| [`spaceman schedule get`](#spaceman-schedule-get) | Show a schedule with its recent occurrences |
| [`spaceman schedule list`](#spaceman-schedule-list) | A space's schedules |
| [`spaceman schedule preview`](#spaceman-schedule-preview) | The next occurrences of a schedule definition, without saving it |
| [`spaceman schedule update`](#spaceman-schedule-update) | Edit a schedule (only the flags given change) |

## spaceman schedule create

Add a schedule.

```sh
spaceman schedule create [flags]
```

API: `create-schedule` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman schedule create --space payments --name nightly --kind cron --cron "0 2 * * *" --timezone Europe/Vilnius \
  --target task --title "Nightly dependency review" --role worker
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--anchor` | string |  | RFC 3339 start of the interval |
| `--body` | string |  | body of each created item |
| `--body-file` | string |  | read --body from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--catch-up-max` | integer |  | most occurrences to catch up |
| `--cron` | string |  | cron expression (kind cron) |
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `--every` | integer |  | interval in seconds (kind interval) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--kind` | string |  | cron or interval (required) |
| `--missed` | string |  | skip, run_once or catch_up |
| `--name` | string |  | name (required) |
| `--priority` | string |  | low, normal, high or urgent |
| `--role` | string |  | assignee role (task target) |
| `--skip-if-open` | bool |  | skip while the previous item is still open |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--target` | string |  | inbox or task (required) |
| `--timezone` | string |  | IANA time zone of the cron expression |
| `--title` | string |  | title of each created item (required) |
